note: Phase 2 sources. Phase 1 sources (S01-S14) and evidence (E###) are reused by reference with the tag [P1:E###].

confidence_scale.A: Official platform documentation, regulator guidance or first-party data
confidence_scale.B: Probability survey or research organisation with stated n and method
confidence_scale.C: Vendor data or survey with stated n but non-representative frame
confidence_scale.D: Secondary compilation with no stated n or period

sources.title: 2025 Google Ads Benchmarks
sources.sample_definition: 16,446 US search campaigns (Google Ads and Microsoft Ads), Apr 2024-Mar 2025; at least 64 campaigns per category
sources.methodology: Medians of campaigns managed or analysed by the publisher
sources.limitations: Advertisers are the publisher's clients; no contractor-software row. Home & Home Improvement advertisers sell to homeowners, not to contractors.
sources.how_verified: Page read directly on 2026-11-23; figures copied from the page tables or text.
